description: Canonical Aether lens registry for the projection engine (A8). A lens is a composable viewing frame a projection applies over canonical Aether truth — a declared, typed refinement of how a 360 is asked and rendered. One default base lens ('standard') plus domain/capability overlay lenses that compose additively via the projection composition algebra. Overlays declare their base lens; composition is order-stable and grain-aware. A lens never owns canonical truth and never adds a write path.

lenses.description: The default lens: the plain, unadorned projection over canonical Aether truth — identity, relationship facts, graph, evidence, temporal, measurement. The identity element of lens composition; composing any overlay onto Standard leaves Standard intact.

Foregrounds temporal structure — state over time, transitions, validity, bitemporal history, correction deltas. When composed with COMPARE/CORRECTION_DIFF modes it is the dominant lens for change detection.
Views a subject through place — locations, regions, geo observations, movement. Composes with the geographic360 projection's context-capsule semantics.
Views a subject as a member of a population or cohort — definitions, membership, clustering, comparison baselines.
Foregrounds the relationship graph — connections, edges, hop structure, graph motifs. Composes with the relationship360 projection.
Views the subject as a sequence of episodes — events, boundaries, continuity, arc structure.
Foregrounds journey structure — touchpoints, stages, path, completion. Composes with the episode360 / outcome360 journey semantics.
Views the subject through outbound communication — channels, messages, delivery, engagement. Composes with the communication360 projection.
Foregrounds campaign structure — campaign facts, touchpoints, quality, source mapping. Composes with the campaign360 projection.
Views conversions through attribution — credits, models, touchpoint contributions. Composes with the outcome360 measurement engine.
Views the subject through economic value — flows, positions, obligations, allocations, settlements, cost/margin/exposure. Composes with the economic360 projection; never sums mixed currencies.
Views the subject through outcomes — state, finality, transitions, chains, journey completion. Composes with the outcome360 projection.
Views the subject through infrastructure — entities, deployments, state, relationships among infrastructure facts. Composes with the infrastructure360 projection (read-only).
Views the subject through agentic structure — agents, access, tool use, executions. Composes with the agent360 / execution360 projections.
Foregrounds execution — actions taken, jobs, flows, resources consumed, outcomes produced. Composes with the execution360 projection.
Views the subject through risk — risk outputs, model governance, capability risk, exposure. Composes with the risk360 projection.
Foregrounds fraudulent structure — fraud synthesis, graph motifs, anomaly concentration. Composes with the fraud360 projection.
Views the subject through trust — reputation signals, provenance of the underlying truth, confidence of sources.
Views the subject through consent — consent state, historical consent evaluation, permitted purposes. Composes with policy evaluation; never leaks a use outside consented purposes.
Views the subject through policy — governance constraints, export class, distillation risk, entitlements. A policy-supressed lens set drops the affected sections rather than rendering them.
Views the subject through wallet structure — wallet identities, balances, on-chain positions. Composes with the economic360 wallet/payment authorities.
Foregrounds payment structure — payments, settlements, refunds, obligations. Composes with the economic360 payment authorities.
Views the subject through its sources — provider registry, source provenance, ingestion health, schema, coverage. Composes with the source360 projection.
Foregrounds evidence — evidence refs, provenance, grounding of every claim. Every claim rendered under this lens must carry evidence refs or be marked ungrounded.
Views the subject through data quality — completeness, freshness, confidence, limitations. A data-quality section always accompanies the sections it qualifies.
Views the subject through operations — operational health, coverage, workbench state. Composes with the operational_workbench projections.
Foregrounds deployment structure — deployments, rollouts, environments, target states. Composes with the infrastructure360 projection.
Views the subject through security posture — security state, exposure, hardening status. Composes with the infrastructure360 security authorities.
